engineV5AuditedGeneration.why: The security audit (docs/AUDIT.md) found five High and twelve Medium defects. This generation carries all of them: signed payouts bound to the owner, the lien guard on addCollateral, pre-transfer deposit pricing with the ERC-4626 virtual offset, both position-mode balance deltas, an oracle-bounded exit, priced and capped shield credit, reserve captured at initialisation, engine handovers refused with live loans, bad-debt write-off, safe transfers, round-up fees.
